import json,shutil,time
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from agent_memory_eval.contracts.core import canonical,digest
from agent_memory_eval.recording.journal import BlobStore,Journal
OUT=Path('outputs/writer-memory-20261116');source=Path('runs/tau2-baseline-luna-deepseek1017-train-01')
original=digest((source/'log.jsonl').read_bytes());first=json.loads((source/'log.jsonl').open().readline());results=[]
for enabled in (False,True):
 target=OUT/('cache-on' if enabled else 'cache-off');shutil.copytree(source,target)
 try:
  with Journal(target,first['experiment_id']) as journal:
   verifier=journal.blobs if enabled else BlobStore(target)
   if not enabled:journal.blobs.verify=verifier.verify
   before_state=digest(canonical(journal.state))
   count=[0,0];raw=verifier.get
   def counted(ref):
    count[0]+=1;count[1]+=(target/ref['path']).stat().st_size
    return raw(ref)
   samples=[]
   with patch.object(verifier,'get',side_effect=counted):
    for repeat in range(3):
     start=time.perf_counter();journal.append([]);samples.append(time.perf_counter()-start)
   assert digest(canonical(journal.state))==before_state
   rows=dict(cache_enabled=enabled,source_commits=len(journal.scan['records'])-3,appends=3,seconds=samples,verification_get_calls=count[0],verification_get_bytes=count[1],final_state_sha256=digest(canonical(journal.state)))
   results.append(rows);print(json.dumps(rows),flush=True)
 finally:shutil.rmtree(target)
assert results[0]['final_state_sha256']==results[1]['final_state_sha256']
assert digest((source/'log.jsonl').read_bytes())==original
(OUT/'blob-cache-measurement.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(source_log_sha256=original,source_preserved=True,measurements=results,new_model_or_catalog_calls=0),indent=2)+'\n')

import hashlib, importlib.util, json, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('audit_preserved_runs',ROOT/'scripts/audit_preserved_runs.py')
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
functions=module.auditors()
from agent_memory_eval.recording.journal import Journal
from agent_memory_eval.contracts.core import canonical,digest
assert 'audit-baseline-code' in sys.modules[Journal.__module__].__file__
rows=[('decision-replay-120','decision_replay','tau2-decision-replay-luna-120-01','decision-replay-summary.json'),('baseline-train','baseline','tau2-baseline-luna-deepseek1017-train-01','baseline-summary.json'),('delivery-48','delivery','tau2-delivery-luna-deepseek1017-development-01','delivery-summary.json'),('guided-memory','memory','tau2-memory-luna-deepseek1017-check-01','memory-summary.json')]
rows += [('autonomy-'+str(i),'autonomy','tau2-autonomy-luna-deepseek1017-pilot-0'+str(i),'pilot-summary.json') for i in (1,2)]
rows += [('connection-'+str(i),'connection',folder,'connection-summary.json') for i,folder in enumerate(['tau2-openrouter-luna-check-01','tau2-openrouter-luna-deepseek1017-check-01','tau2-openrouter-luna-deepseek1017-check-02','tau2-openrouter-luna-deepseek1017-check-03'],1)]
entries=[]
for identity,auditor,folder,summary in rows:
 path=ROOT/'runs'/folder
 before=module.inventory(path);start=time.perf_counter();result=functions[auditor](path)
 assert module.inventory(path)==before
 refs=[dict(path=name,sha256=digest((path/name).read_bytes())) for name in ('log.jsonl',summary)]
 entry=dict(id=identity,auditor=auditor,path='runs/'+folder,input_refs=refs,audit_sha256=digest(canonical(result)))
 entries.append(entry)
 (ROOT/'outputs/writer-memory-20261116'/('baseline-'+identity+'.json')).write_bytes(canonical(result)+b'\n')
 print(json.dumps(dict(id=identity,audit_sha256=entry['audit_sha256'],seconds=time.perf_counter()-start)),flush=True)
registry=dict(format='agent-memory-preserved-audit-baselines/v1',baseline_commit='7f4d0f33',baseline_source='Fixed Git worktree at 7f4d0f3; full existing auditor return values, no raw changes.',comparison='SHA-256 of the complete canonical JSON audit result, no field subset and no requirement to match current source hashes.',runs=entries)
import subprocess
registry['baseline_commit']=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','7f4d0f3'],text=True).strip()
with (ROOT/'protocols/reproductions/preserved-run-audits-v1.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(registry,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
